nodes.title: W9 (main: the c5-maths-ch01-t01 place-value board masked its hundreds digit '?' but wrote '10,500' under the boxes): when a board writes a withheld DIGIT in a cell of its own (a place-value box, a column), every number on it that CONTAINS that digit is a reveal too, and regate masks the whole number '?'. A board that never splits a number into digits is unchanged ('15 cm' beside an answer of 5 is no reveal). Tested in tests/r7-motion-templates.test.mjs.
nodes.reversal: none: a board never shows its own answer

md.decisions:
## fx-r7-w9-digit-in-number: a hidden digit stays hidden (2026-11-04)

When the board hides a digit the child must find ("?" in the hundreds box), it no longer writes the whole number underneath that would give the digit away.
